name: Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT)
issuer: the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
note: Colombia's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: under article 555-1 of the Tax Code the NIT is the number DIAN assigns to taxpayers, responsible parties, withholding agents and filers, given on enrolment in the Tax Registry (RUT) (article 1.6.1.2.2 of Decree 1625 of 2016); not issued automatically to individuals. An individual's NIT is the number of their identity document plus a verification digit; for citizenship-card numbers up to 99999999 it is that number, for Colombians whose number is from 1000000000 the same number, for foreigners a number from 600000001 to 799999999. The format holds the current Colombian form (a ten-digit identification number from 1000000000 and the verification digit, eleven characters); older eight-digit cards and foreigners' nine-digit numbers aren't drawn. The verification digit's rule isn't given, so `check` is left out. Read as given on registration, to anyone who registers; needed for tax. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Colombia: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: In accordance with article 555-1 of the Tax Code, the tax identification number (TIN), is the identification number assigned by the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) to taxpayers, responsible parties, withholding agents and those obliged to file tax returns ... The assignment of the TIN is carried out through the registration in the Tax Registry (RUT) ... For individuals, the Tax Identification Number – TIN consist of 1 and up to 13 digits plus a verification digit included by the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN). ... For Colombians whose identification number is from the number 1000000000, the TIN corresponds to the same identification number plus a verification digit.
